title: Recovery.seconds prose says 'the last one'; the 7uv fill sums the spans
description:
The bundle's $defs.recovery.seconds description ("How long the last one took, where anything measured it") and the Go field's doc comment describe a per-occurrence span, while the tick's rule — and this fill — state the SUM of the stated suspension durations across the counted host_suspended lines. A renderer reading the contract prose would print the wrong number for any run that slept twice; the bundle's wording should be re-cut to name the sum the fill states (or the fill changed, if the prose is what binds).
evidence: contracts/status-model.json $defs.recovery.properties.seconds description; internal/statusmodel/verdict.go buildRecovered's sleep accumulation
